cases.title: A saved item survives a new session
given: The approved fixed test user is signed in.
Item A is available and is not in this user's saved-items list.

when: The user signs out, signs back in, and opens the saved-items list.

then.expect: The list contains item A exactly once.

data.setup: Coordinate exclusive use of the shared test account and prepare item A as unsaved. Other saved items may remain.
data.cleanup: Remove this test's saved item A if present, including after partial failure. Leave other account data and the account itself intact.

cases.title: A zero quantity is refused without changing the cart
cases.source: Hypothetical cart rule; replace with the product's actual approved contract
given: The approved buyer is authenticated and has a prepared cart.

when: Send POST /cart/items for an available item with quantity 0.

then.expect: The API returns HTTP 400 with error code INVALID_QUANTITY.
The cart contents and total remain unchanged.

data.setup: Reserve the shared buyer and prepare known cart contents through authorized setup.
data.cleanup: Restore only test-owned cart changes, including if the invalid request incorrectly succeeded.
